name: devops-doctor
description: Read-only DevOps and SRE investigation workflows for GitLab CI/CD, AWS infrastructure, incidents, cost, security drift, observability, and rollback planning.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose cloud, CI/CD, and production incidents safely.
interface.longDescription: Evidence-led DevOps workflows with scoped readiness checks, bounded parallel collection, current-commit GitLab review gates, shared secret sanitization, Terraform risk analysis, cost comparisons, saved-snapshot drift, and validation/rollback planning. Cloud diagnostics are read-only; production mutations require authorization. DevOps Team coordinates available native subagents with scoped roles, exclusive file/read ownership, dependency ordering, independent review, and offline handoff consistency checks.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this GitLab or AWS issue using evidence only.
Review this GitLab merge request and identify deployment risks.
Investigate this AWS ECS or Fargate failure and provide a safe rollback plan.
Use $devops-team to investigate this incident with scoped specialists and verify their findings.
